test.create_query: CREATE TABLE upp_iceberg ENGINE = IcebergS3(perf_s3_data, filename = 'lakes/uk_price_paid_iceberg/default/iceberg_table/')
CREATE TABLE upp_delta ENGINE = DeltaLake(perf_s3_data, filename = 'lakes/uk_price_paid_delta/')
CREATE TABLE upp_hudi ENGINE = Hudi(perf_s3_data, filename = 'lakes/uk_price_paid_hudi/')
test.fill_query: SELECT throwIf(count() != 18) FROM system.iceberg_files WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'upp_iceberg' AND content = 0

SELECT throwIf(ifNull((SELECT groupArray(tuple(*)) FROM (SELECT c14, count(), avg(toUInt64OrZero(c2)) FROM upp_{format} GROUP BY c14 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10)) != (SELECT groupArray(tuple(*)) FROM (SELECT c14, count(), avg(toUInt64OrZero(c2)) FROM s3(perf_s3_data, filename = 'lakes/uk_price_paid_iceberg/default/iceberg_table/data/*.parquet') GROUP BY c14 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10)), 1))

SELECT throwIf(ifNull((SELECT count(), sum(toUInt64OrZero(c2)) FROM upp_{format} WHERE c12 = 'LONDON') != (SELECT count(), sum(toUInt64OrZero(c2)) FROM s3(perf_s3_data, filename = 'lakes/uk_price_paid_iceberg/default/iceberg_table/data/*.parquet') WHERE c12 = 'LONDON'), 1)) SETTINGS delta_lake_enable_engine_predicate = 0
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS upp_{format} SYNC
